request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural morning light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: clothing, packaging, tags and objects are plain. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the person, whole, inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

The camera has a clear, unobstructed view from a few steps away at eye level: nothing stands between the camera and the person, and the face is fully visible and in sharp focus.

The setting is a wide gravel path beside a small lake in a green park on a bright, calm morning, with grass and trees softly out of focus behind. The camera is at chest height a few steps in front, and the runner is seen whole from head to running shoes. Running is the most obvious thing in the photo: a real, easy jogging stride toward the camera, one foot clearly off the ground, elbows bent, a relaxed smile.

Image 1 shows Ana, only so that her father clearly looks like her; Ana is NOT in the new photo. Create a new photograph of Ana's FATHER running alone on the same lakeside path: a fit man of about 60, clearly older than Ana but much younger than a grandfather, with Ana's dark eyes and warm smile, short dark hair grey at the sides, a neat grey moustache and no glasses. He wears a plain dark-green running T-shirt, black running shorts and grey running shoes. No one else is on the path.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
